w.text: Provides 44.1% CRIT DMG, 28% ATK, and up to 68% Plunging Attack CRIT DMG at R1, making it Varesa’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: Provides 66.2% CRIT DMG and boosts Elemental Skill DMG and overall Elemental DMG, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Varesa.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and a random ATK, Elemental DMG, or EM buff, offering strong but inconsistent damage boosts for Varesa.

w.name: Flowing Purity
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and a random ATK, Elemental DMG, or EM buff, offering strong but inconsistent damage boosts for Varesa.

a.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and up to 40% Elemental DMG Bonus at R5, making it a strong craftable F2P option for Varesa when paired with a healer.
Provides 15% DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while Varesa is in Nightsoul’s Blessing, making it her best-in-slot artifact set.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 36% ATK, making it a solid 2-piece combination for boosting Varesa’s Plunging Attack damage.

t.name: Plunge & Punishment
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika adds off-field Pyro and buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse provides healing, ATK buffs, and Pyro/Electro RES shred.

t.name: Natlan CrossFit
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Durin adds off-field Pyro, Iansan boosts ATK, and Chevreuse heals, buffs ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

t.name: Air Traffic Control
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Iansan boosts ATK, and Xianyun buffs Plunging Attacks and heals.

t.name: Bat Mobile
t.text: Varesa drives Plunging Attack damage, Mavuika provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Ororon adds Electro damage and Scroll buffs, and Chevreuse heals, boosts ATK, and shreds Pyro/Electro RES.

seo.about: Varesa is a 5-star Electro Main DPS built around fast Charged Attacks and powerful Plunging Attacks. Her Skill builds Nightsoul points, unlocking an enhanced state and a special Burst for high Plunge damage.

w.name: Peak Patrol Song
w.text: Provides 82.7% DEF and, at R1, grants up to 16% DEF and 20% All Elemental DMG Bonus to Albedo. After two Normal Attacks, it also buffs the entire team by up to 25.6% All Elemental DMG Bonus based on his DEF. An excellent support weapon and Albedo’s best choice for boosting team damage.

w.name: Uraku Misugiri
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG and, at R1, grants 20% DEF and 24% Elemental Skill DMG, doubled to 40% DEF and 48% Skill DMG after nearby Geo damage. Albedo’s best weapon for maximizing his personal damage.

w.name: Cinnabar Spindle
w.text: Provides 69% DEF and, at R5, increases Elemental Skill DMG by 80% of DEF. Albedo’s signature event weapon and his best 4-star option, maximizing his off-field Transient Blossom damage.

w.name: Harbinger of Dawn
w.text: Provides 46.9% CRIT DMG and, at R5, grants 28% CRIT Rate while Albedo stays above 90% HP. An excellent F2P option that boosts his off-field Skill damage, especially if you don't have Cinnabar Spindle.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: CRIT Rate substat with HP-scaled ATK.

w.name: Flute of Ezpitzal
w.text: Forgeable DEF% sword.

a.text: Provides 30% DEF and up to 24% additional DEF and 24% Geo DMG Bonus at max stacks. Albedo’s best-in-slot set, maximizing his DEF-scaling Transient Blossom damage.

Provides 20% Elemental Skill DMG and an additional 25%, plus another 25% while off-field. An excellent alternative to Husk of Opulent Dreams, bringing Albedo’s off-field Transient Blossom damage to a similar level, especially with Cinnabar Spindle.

Provides 20% Energy Recharge and, after using an Elemental Skill, grants the team 20% Geo DMG Bonus for 20s. With Hexerei: Secret Rite, this increases to 40% Geo DMG Bonus plus 40% of the active character’s Elemental DMG Bonus. A strong support set for Albedo, trading personal damage for team buffs.

t.name: Rock & Reload
t.text: Navia leads on-field Geo damage, Albedo adds off-field Geo damage and Crystallize, Durin provides Pyro application and RES shred, and Nicole supplies teamwide ATK buffs and shielding.

t.name: Chemical Romance
t.text: Albedo provides off-field Geo damage and team buffs, Lohen leads on-field Cryo damage, Durin adds off-field Pyro damage and Melt synergy, and Nicole boosts the team while providing shielding.

t.name: Fullmetal Father
t.text: Albedo adds off-field Geo damage and Crystallize, Arlecchino leads on-field Pyro damage, Xilonen shreds RES and boosts elemental damage, and Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding.

t.name: Hopeless Impact
t.text: Noelle leads on-field Geo damage and provides healing, Albedo adds off-field Geo damage, Durin contributes Pyro damage and Geo RES shred, and Gorou boosts DEF and Geo damage.

seo.about: Albedo is a low-field-time Geo off-field DPS who deals in consistent DEF scaling damage. His Hexerei upgrades boost both his damage and team utility.
cons: Constructs can break if not Hex

w.name: Fang of the Mountain King
w.text: Provides 11% CRIT Rate and boosts Elemental Skill and Burst DMG by up to 60% at R1, making it Kinich’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: Provides 11% CRIT Rate and, at R1, grants 28% ATK and 20% CRIT DMG, making it a strong 5-star alternative for Kinich.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: Provides 27.6% CRIT Rate and up to 30% DMG Bonus at R1, making it a strong 4-star option for Kinich. Its stacks are reduced when he takes damage.

w.name: Earth Shaker
w.text: Provides 27.6% ATK and up to 32% Elemental Skill DMG at R5 after a Pyro reaction, making it a strong craftable F2P option for Kinich.

a.text: Provides 15% DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while Kinich consumes Nightsoul points, making it his best-in-slot artifact set.
Provides 18% ATK and up to 50% DMG Bonus while Burning enemies are present, making it a strong alternative for Kinich in Burning teams.
Provides 15% Dendro DMG and 20% Elemental Skill DMG, offering a flexible option for boosting Kinich’s Dendro and Skill damage.

t.name: Kinich Me Outside
t.text: Kinich drives on-field Burning damage, Emilie adds off-field Dendro damage, Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding, and Durin supplies Pyro application, Dendro RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Ajaw & Order
t.text: Kinich deals the damage and Bennett buffs the team.

t.name: Let Him Cook
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Iansan boosts ATK and DMG, Bennett provides ATK buffs and healing, and Xiangling supplies off-field Pyro damage.

t.name: Free to Burn
t.text: Kinich drives Burning damage, Pyro Traveler provides off-field Pyro and buffs, Bennett boosts ATK and heals, and Iansan adds ATK buffs and DMG Bonus.

seo.about: Kinich is a 5★ Dendro on-field DPS who builds Nightsoul points to fire powerful Scalespiker Cannons. Burning and Burgeon help him generate points faster and maximize his damage.

w.name: Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage
w.text: Provides massive CRIT DMG, ATK, Charged Attack, and Burst bonuses that directly boost Chasca’s overall damage.

w.name: Aqua Simulacra
w.text: Provides massive CRIT DMG and a universal DMG bonus, making it an excellent 5-star alternative for boosting Chasca’s overall damage.

w.name: The First Great Magic
w.text: substat with a Charged Attack DMG bonus that grows on each consecutive charged shot.

w.name: Thundering Pulse
w.text: substat, ATK passive and stacking Normal Attack DMG.

w.name: Flower-Wreathed Feathers
w.text: Provides 41.3% ATK and up to 36% Charged Attack DMG, making it a strong 4-star option that directly boosts Chasca’s converted shots.

w.name: Scion of the Blazing Sun
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and increases Charged Attack DMG after hitting an enemy, making it a solid 4-star option for Chasca.

w.name: Song of Stillness
w.text: Very high base ATK, but the passive only grants its DMG Bonus if healing keeps arriving.

a.text: Obsidian Codex is Chasca’s BiS because it provides 15% universal DMG Bonus and 40% CRIT Rate while she’s in her Nightsoul state, massively boosting her converted elemental shots.
VV ss a strong situational support option, especially when supporting one or two primary elemental damage types. You should aim for Obsidian Codex as her clear BiS.
Provides 36% CRIT Rate with Furina and boosts Charged Attack DMG, making it a strong alternative to Obsidian Codex.

t.name: Hexecutioners
t.text: Chasca drives elemental damage, Citlali shields and shreds RES, Durin provides off-field Pyro, and Nicole buffs the team.

t.name: Starstruck
t.text: Chasca drives converted elemental damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Bennett boosts ATK and heals, and Iansan adds ATK buffs and Scroll support.

t.name: Moonstruck
t.text: Chasca drives converted elemental damage, Columbina boosts Lunar reactions, Ineffa provides off-field Electro and Lunar-Charged damage, and Nicole buffs the team and strengthens Hexerei synergy.

t.name: Budget Airlines
t.text: Chasca drives elemental damage, Ororon provides off-field Electro and buffs, Bennett boosts ATK and heals, and Diona provides shielding and healing

seo.about: Chasca is a 5-star Anemo Bow DPS who uses her Skill to enter Nightsoul’s Blessing, taking flight and loads six Charged Attack shells that convert to her teams’ elements. She excels with PHEC teammates.

w.name: Splendor of Tranquil Waters
w.text: Splendor maximizes Furina’s damage, while Favonius can be better in Stygian for team Energy and Burst uptime.

w.name: Key of Khaj-Nisut
w.text: Key of Khaj-Nisut boosts Furina’s HP and provides additional teamwide EM, strengthening her HP-scaling damage and reaction support.

w.name: Primordial Jade Cutter
w.text: Primordial Jade Cutter provides CRIT Rate and HP, improving Furina’s personal damage and HP-scaling Skill.

w.name: Favonius Sword
w.text: Favonius provides Energy Recharge and generates teamwide particles, helping Furina maintain Burst uptime and support the entire team.

w.name: The Dockhand's Assistant
w.text: % substat with an ATK buff triggered by being healed.

w.name: Festering Desire
w.text: Budget pick: Energy Recharge plus Skill CRIT Rate and Skill DMG.

w.name: Fleuve Cendre Ferryman
w.text: Free fishing sword: Energy Recharge substat, Skill CRIT Rate, and bonus ER after casting Skill.

w.name: Wolf-Fang
w.text: 4-star with CRIT Rate and ramping Skill / Burst DMG on crit hits.

a.text: Golden Troupe boosts Furina’s Elemental Skill damage by up to 70%, making it her best set for off-field damage.
Tenacity boosts Furina’s HP and provides a teamwide ATK buff, offering support for ATK-scaling carries at the cost of her personal damage.
Combines an HP boost with Hydro DMG Bonus to strengthen Furina’s Skill damage.

t.name: Fine Dining & Violence
t.text: Skirk drives on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Escoffier shreds Cryo/Hydro RES and heals, and Vodyanitsa adds further RES shred and damage buffs.

t.name: Divas & Detonations
t.text: Navia drives Geo damage, Furina buffs the team and enables Crystallize, Columbina supports Lunar reactions, and Linnea provides healing and Geo buffs.

t.name: Furina’s Fitness Club
t.text: Varesa drives Electro damage, Furina provides off-field Hydro and DMG buffs, Xilonen shreds RES and heals, and Iansan boosts ATK and provides additional support.

t.name: Lohen Up Places
t.text: Lohen drives Freeze damage, Furina provides Hydro and DMG buffs, Escoffier shreds Cryo/Hydro RES and heals, and Mona boosts damage with Omen and Hexerei buffs

seo.about: Furina is a universal buffer and Sub-DPS, boosting nearly all forms of team damage while dealing impressive damage herself. She needs strong healers to quickly build Fanfare.

w.name: Starsealed Edict
w.text: Provides 88.2% CRIT DMG, up to 168 EM, and up to 36% Stellar-Conduct CRIT DMG at R1, making it Mitya’s signature and best-in-slot weapon.

w.name: A Thousand Floating Dreams
w.text: Provides 265 EM and grants Mitya additional EM plus 40 teamwide EM at R1, making it an excellent off-field support option.

w.name: Kagura's Verity
w.text: Kagura’s Verity boosts Mitya’s Elemental Skill damage and CRIT DMG, making it a strong offensive option for personal damage.

w.name: Winter's Heavy Heart
w.text: Provides 55.1% CRIT DMG and boosts EM and Stellar Glimmer damage based on Cryo and Electro teammates, making it a strong 4-star option for Mitya.

w.name: Clash of Kings
w.text: Provides 27.6% CRIT Rate and, after using an Elemental Skill, grants ATK and EM bonuses, making it a strong 4-star option for Mitya.

a.text: Provides 18% ATK and boosts Stellar-Conduct damage by 40%, with 16% CRIT Rate against affected enemies. A strong option for Mitya in Stellar-Conduct teams. Mitya wants EM, not ATK% so until a set for stellar is released with that, this is one of his BiS sets.
Provides 80 EM and up to 150 additional EM or 42% ATK, boosting Mitya’s reaction damage and ATK scaling.
Grants 18% ATK and boosts teamwide Stellar Glimmer DMG by 50%, making it a strong off-field support set for Mitya.

t.name: On-Field Live Wire
t.text: Mitya adds off-field damage and Yae Miko adds off-field damage.

t.name: Off-Field Puppet
t.text: Sandrone drives on-field Cryo and Stellar-Conduct damage, Odette enables Stellar-Conduct, Valeriy provides off-field Electro support, and Mitya adds off-field damage and reaction support.

t.name: Maximum Security
t.text: Wriothesley drives on-field Cryo damage, Mitya provides off-field damage and Stellar-Conduct support, Cryo Traveler adds Cryo application, and Valeriy provides Electro support.

t.name: Economitya F2P
t.text: Mitya adds off-field damage and qiqi buffs the team.

seo.about: Flexible Stellar-Conduct unit who can be played as either an on-field DPS or off-field support. His C0 dmg is solid, while his Cons significantly boost both his personal dmg and team utility.

w.name: Summit Shaper
w.text: Summit Shaper gives Valeriy massive ATK scaling, strengthening his ATK-based shields and support buffs/increases ATK when shielded.

w.name: Skyward Blade
w.text: High Base ATK boosts his support scaling, while ER improves Burst uptime.

w.name: Finale of the Deep
w.text: Amenoma Kageuchi provides substantial ATK% and passive Energy restoration, helping Valeriy maintain his Burst uptime.

w.name: Sacrificial Sword
w.text: Sacrificial Sword provides high Energy Recharge and a chance to reset his Skill cooldown for more frequent utility.

a.text: Heart of the Furnace boosts Valeriy's ATK and can provide a massive teamwide Stellar Glimmer DMG bonus when he triggers the reaction.
Noblesse Oblige is a strong alternative for Valeriy, providing a 20% teamwide ATK buff after his Burst, especially when another teammate already carries Heart of the Furnace.

t.name: Current Situation
t.text: Mitya drives SSC damage, Odette amplifies reactions, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Valeriy provides buffs and team support.

t.name: Short Circuit
t.text: Cyno drives sustained Electro damage, Odette amplifies reactions, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Valeriy provides buffs and team support.

t.name: Guilty as Charged
t.text: Clorinde drives Electro damage, Durin enables reactions, Chevreuse boosts Overloaded damage and shreds RES, while Valeriy provides buffs and team support.

t.name: Budget Conductors
t.text: Mitya drives SSC damage, Cryo Traveler supports Cryo application, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Valeriy provides buffs and team support.

seo.about: Valeriy is a flexible support who provides shielding and buffs Electro teams, especially those built around SSC. Best in teams that can fully use his buffs. He is a specialized support.

w.name: Gest of the Mighty Wolf
w.text: Provides 33.1% CRIT Rate, 10% ATK SPD, and stacking DMG and CRIT DMG bonuses, perfectly complementing Varka’s fast attacks and Hexerei synergy.

w.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate, massive ATK, and CRIT DMG buffs, making it a powerful 5-star alternative that boosts Varka’s overall damage.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: Provides CRIT Rate and stacking DMG bonuses, making it a strong 4-star option as long as Varka avoids taking damage.

w.name: Prototype Archaic
w.text: Provides a high Base ATK and ATK% bonus, making it a reliable craftable F2P option for Varka.

names: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
a.text: Provides 18% ATK from its 2-piece bonus and 25% ATK plus 20% CRIT Rate from its 4-piece bonus, making it Varka’s best-in-slot set.
Provides Anemo DMG, 40% Normal/Charged Attack DMG, and 10% ATK SPD, making it a solid alternative if you already have strong pieces.
Combines 15% Anemo DMG and 15% Pyro DMG, offering a flexible 2-piece option for boosting Varka’s pyro damage. (Must have 2 pyro teammates).

t.name: Knight Shift
t.text: Varka drives Anemo and Pyro damage, Venti groups enemies and shreds RES, Nicole provides ATK buffs and shielding, and Durin adds off-field Pyro damage and RES shred.

t.name: Prune & Punishment
t.text: Varka drives Anemo and Cryo damage, Prune provides teamwide buffs and Anemo support, Odette enables Stellar Swirl and adds Cryo damage, and Qiqi provides healing and additional Cryo application.

t.name: Watt the Fischl
t.text: Varka drives Anemo and Electro damage, Prune provides ATK and DMG buffs, Ineffa adds off-field Electro and Lunar-Charged damage, and Fischl supplies additional Electro damage.

t.name: Category Varka
t.text: Varka drives Anemo and Hydro damage, Prune provides ATK and DMG buffs, Furina adds off-field Hydro damage and team buffs, and Vodyanitsa heals, shreds RES, and boosts Varka’s damage.

seo.about: Varka is an Anemo on-field DPS built around fast, aggressive combat and reaction driven teams. He shines with strong supports, especially in Stellar Swirl teams.

w.name: Wolf's Gravestone
w.text: Enormous base ATK plus a team-wide ATK buff and bonus damage against low-HP enemies.

w.name: Redhorn Stonethresher
w.text: Redhorn provides massive CRIT DMG and boosts Diluc's Normal and Charged Attack damage, making it a strong CRIT-focused alternative.

w.name: Serpent Spine
w.text: substat and a ramping all-DMG bonus tied to field time.

w.name: Blackcliff Slasher
w.text: substat and stackable ATK on kills — best in multi-wave chambers where adds keep refreshing the buff.

w.name: Rainslasher
w.text: Budget Vaporize option: Elemental Mastery substat and 20% extra damage against Hydro - or Electro…

w.name: Mailed Flower
w.text: substat plus an ATK bump after triggering a reaction.

a.text: Crimson Witch boosts Diluc's Pyro damage and reaction damage, making it ideal for maximizing his Vaporize and Melt potential.
Marechaussee Hunter provides up to 36% CRIT Rate when Diluc's HP fluctuates, making it a strong option for consistent CRIT builds.
Gilded Dreams boosts Diluc's EM and ATK, improving his Vaporize and Melt damage through stronger reactions.

t.name: Melt Force One
t.text: Diluc delivers powerful Plunge attacks, Xianyun enables Plunging and boosts damage, Citlali provides Melt support and RES shred, and Bennett buffs ATK.

t.name: Splash Landing
t.text: Furina's HP fluctuations activate Marechaussee Hunter's 36% CRIT Rate bonus, while Xianyun enables Plunges and Bennett boosts Diluc's ATK.

t.name: Dawn & Tonic
t.text: Diluc delivers powerful Plunge attacks, Xianyun enables Plunging, Kazuha boosts Pyro damage and shreds RES, and Bennett provides massive ATK buffs.

t.name: F2P-Wan Kenobi
t.text: Diluc drives Pyro damage, Xingqiu enables consistent Vaporize, Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES, and Bennett provides ATK buffs and healing.

seo.about: Diluc is a 5-star Pyro Claymore DPS with straightforward combos and strong reaction damage. His flexible Skill and low-cost Burst make him easy to play, especially in Vaporize and Plunge teams.

w.name: Surf's Up
w.text: Surf’s Up provides massive CRIT DMG, boosts Mualani’s HP, and increases her Normal Attack damage, making it her best-in-slot weapon for powerful Sharky’s Bites and Vaporize hits.

w.name: Tome of the Eternal Flow
w.text: Tome of the Eternal Flow provides massive CRIT DMG and HP%, boosting Mualani’s damage, though its Charged Attack bonus is less useful since her Sharky’s Bites deal Normal Attack damage.

w.name: Sacrificial Jade
w.text: Sacrificial Jade provides CRIT Rate, a massive HP boost, and EM to strengthen Mualani’s Vaporize damage—but watch for CRIT overcapping with Obsidian Codex.

w.name: Ring of Yaxche
w.text: Ring of Yaxche provides a hefty HP% boost and increases Mualani’s Normal Attack damage after using her Skill, making it a strong craftable F2P option.

w.name: The Widsith
w.text: On-switch random buffs include Elemental Mastery or DMG%.

a.text: Obsidian Codex provides 15% increased damage and 40% CRIT Rate, making it Mualani’s best set and freeing up artifact substats for HP%, EM, and CRIT DMG.
Unfinished Reverie boosts Mualani’s damage against Burning enemies, making it a niche option for Burn-Vape teams.
Marechaussee Hunter provides 15% Normal Attack DMG and up to 36% CRIT Rate with Furina, making it a solid alternative for Mualani’s Sharky’s Bites. Obsidian Codex remains stronger overall.

t.name: Sharknado
t.text: Mualani drives massive Vaporize hits, Mavuika provides off-field Pyro, Citlali enables Melt support and shreds RES, and Xilonen further boosts team damage.

t.name: Shark Week
t.text: Mualani drives Vaporize damage, Mavuika provides off-field Pyro, Emilie adds Burning damage, and Xilonen shreds RES and buffs the team.

t.name: Jaws & Order
t.text: Mualani drives Vaporize damage, Furina buffs and applies Hydro, Xiangling provides off-field Pyro, and Xilonen shreds RES and boosts damage.

t.name: Coupon Cabana
t.text: Mualani drives Vaporize damage, Xiangling provides Pyro, Yaoyao heals and supports Bloom reactions, and Sucrose boosts EM and shreds RES.

seo.about: Mualani is an HP scaling Hydro DPS built around huge, front loaded Sharky’s Bite damage. She excels in Vaporize teams, trading rapid attacks for fewer, massive hits.

t.name: Witch Please
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage and enables Forward Melt, Durin provides off-field Pyro and Melt damage, Nicole buffs the team and shields, and Citlali shreds Pyro RES and boosts damage.

t.name: Blizzard Queen
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage, Furina provides Hydro application and DMG buffs, Citlali adds shielding and Cryo application, and Escoffier provides healing, Cryo RES shred, and off-field damage.

t.name: Amber Alerted Us
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage, Vodyanitsa provides Hydro application, healing, and RES shred, Mona boosts damage with Omen, and Escoffier adds Cryo/Hydro RES shred and healing.

t.name: Lohen at Home
t.text: Lohen drives on-field Cryo damage and triggers Reverse Melt, Xiangling provides off-field Pyro, Bennett buffs ATK and heals, and Sucrose boosts EM and enables Hexerei synergy.

seo.about: Lohen is an on-field Cryo DPS who builds resources to unleash powerful Skill attacks. He rewards strong rotations and active off-field teammates.

sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

w.name: Azurelight

Provides 160 Elemental Mastery, making this an excellent alternative for maximizing Lauma's Lunar-Bloom buffs and reaction damage. A strong, flexible combination when farming a dedicated 4-piece set isn't practical.

t.name: Celestial Bloom
t.text: Nefer's Lunar-Bloom team, combining Columbina's Hydro application with Lauma and Nahida's powerful reaction buffs, EM sharing, and Dendro RES reduction. Run Deepwood on Nahida and Silken Moon on Lauma or Columbina. Lacks dedicated healing.

t.name: Mossy Water
t.text: A powerful Lunar-Charged team combining Neuvillette's Hydro damage with Furina's DMG buffs and Ineffa's Electro application, shielding, and reaction support. Excellent AoE damage and strong synergy.

t.name: Leaf It Alone
t.text: A strong F2P-friendly Hyperbloom team built around Alhaitham's Dendro damage and mirror attacks. Xingqiu provides consistent Hydro application and defensive utility, while Kuki triggers Hyperbloom and provides healing. Excellent single-target damage with reliable reaction uptime.

t.name: Four-Star Garden
t.text: A budget-friendly Hyperbloom team combining Aino's off-field Hydro application with Xingqiu's consistent Hydro damage. Kuki triggers Hyperbloom while providing healing, and Lauma supplies powerful Dendro application, reaction buffs, and RES reduction.

seo.about: Lauma is a powerful Dendro support specializing in Lunar-Bloom, offering strong reaction buffs, excellent team synergy, and solid off-field utility.

w.name: Fractured Halo
w.text: Provides valuable CRIT stats and boosts Ineffa's damage, making it a strong option for improving her personal DPS and overall Lunar-Charged damage output.

w.name: Staff of the Scarlet Sands
w.text: Provides high CRIT Rate and converts Elemental Mastery into additional ATK, boosting Ineffa's personal damage while benefiting her reaction-focused builds.

w.name: Prospector's Shovel
w.text: Provides Elemental Mastery to boost Ineffa's reaction damage, making it a budget-friendly option for Lunar-Charged teams.

w.name: "The Catch"
w.text: Provides Energy Recharge and increases Elemental Burst damage and CRIT Rate, helping Ineffa maintain Burst uptime and improve her Burst damage.

a.text: Boosts Elemental Mastery and Lunar reaction damage, making it an excellent set for maximizing Ineffa's Lunar-Charged damage and team synergy.
Provides Elemental Mastery and increases Elemental Energy, making it a useful alternative for supporting Ineffa's Lunar reaction damage and team performance.
Provides Elemental Mastery and an additional ATK or EM bonus based on team composition, boosting Ineffa's reaction damage and overall DPS.

t.name: Moonfall
t.text: This team takes advantage of Aino's Moonsign activation while Ifa drives consistent reactions. Ineffa provides additional damage, shielding, and EM support.

t.name: Storm Surge
t.text: Neuvillette provides consistent Hydro application and powerful on-field damage, while Ineffa and Columbina contribute substantial off-field Lunar-Charged damage. Sucrose provides resistance reduction and EM support.

t.name: Electric Bubbles
t.text: Clorinde takes the field as the primary DPS, while Ineffa and Yelan provide coordinated off-field damage and consistent Lunar-Charged reactions. Sucrose adds resistance reduction and EM support.

t.name: Short Circuit
t.text: Flins leads with powerful on-field Lunar-Charged damage, while Ineffa provides shielding, Electro application, and Lunar-Charged buffs. Columbina supplies Hydro application and reaction buffs, while Sucrose provides EM and resistance reduction.

seo.about: Ineffa is a versatile off-field Electro DPS and Lunar-Charged enabler who provides shielding, strong reaction damage, and valuable team support.
cons: DMG potential depends on team synergy.
